summary:
Seven hollow, billowing shells on elliptical plans, each its own colour: a big draped silver form (NW), a purple drum up to y44 (NE), red, gold, sky blue, magenta and a second silver, with stair and slab crowns and deep folds, all clipped to the footprint.
A straight monorail street (x43..51) runs through the plot. Two grey beams sit at y9..10 on T-pylons, and the white-and-red train stands under a blue lobe that bridges the track. The glass lobbies sit between the forms.
It reads as MoPOP because the coloured metal blobs clash against each other and the monorail passes through them, and the north front has the photo's silver hood over glass, the purple drum and amphitheatre steps.
